WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.InvoiceId,
        c.Country,
        AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) AS average_unit_price
    FROM invoice_averages
),
invoice_deviations AS (
    SELECT
        ia.InvoiceId,
        ia.Country,
        ia.average_unit_price,
        ia.average_unit_price - oa.average_unit_price AS deviation_from_overall
    FROM invoice_averages AS ia
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
),
country_average_deviations AS (
    SELECT Country, AVG(deviation_from_overall) AS average_deviation
    FROM invoice_deviations
    GROUP BY Country
)
SELECT
    d.InvoiceId,
    d.Country,
    d.average_unit_price,
    d.deviation_from_overall,
    d.deviation_from_overall - cad.average_deviation AS deviation_minus_country_average
FROM invoice_deviations AS d
JOIN country_average_deviations AS cad
    ON d.Country = cad.Country
    OR (d.Country IS NULL AND cad.Country IS NULL)
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN d.deviation_from_overall - cad.average_deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    deviation_minus_country_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
